title: Reactor parallel development sharding
summary: Shard the remaining reactor work into isolated worker lanes while keeping the main context responsible for API decisions and final integration. Serial API decisions, module split, first-wave worker merge, and second-wave worker merge are complete. Deferred userspace-run, CoreInit wiring, and bus hardening remain outside this plan.

write_sets.notes: Own the serial API decisions, module facade, progress records, second-wave facade prep, and final integration.
Own the reactor-local InterruptSource seam and Interrupted/Killed wait_event classification. Does not implement POSIX signal routing or AST delivery.
Own task-local AST/preemption markers consumed between polls. Avoid wait.rs and signal policy.
Own counted Completion and closed-set CountdownCompletion over Channel::wait_event. Coordinator adds the module facade before dispatch.
Own synchronous coordination shape for shootdown-style rendezvous. Keep this reactor-local while the substrate lib.rs lease remains active.

steps.title: Close reactor API decisions before worker fanout
steps.notes: Completed in docs/progress/decisions/2026-04-30-reactor-serial-api-prework.md and aligned active wait/bus/reactor/completion docs. Canonical shape: wait_event(channel, mask, protocol, condition), check/register/recheck/park, credit-consuming Completion by default, cancel_task/drain_completed/drain_cancelled, and yield_now.

steps.title: Split tx-reactor lib.rs into worker-owned modules without behavior changes
steps.notes: Completed as a behavior-preserving split into facade, task, waker, scheduler, wait, timer, runtime, ast, preempt, interrupt, and sync_coord modules. cargo test -p tx-reactor passed with 17 tests.

steps.title: Implement generation-safe task handles and task drain/cancel
steps.notes: Dispatched to subagent 019ddd2f-11e2-7d62-b7d6-38d255174e4e, then coordinator-integrated into runtime. Reactor now exposes submit_task, cancel_task, drain_completed, and drain_cancelled over generation-safe TaskKey while preserving submit -> TaskId for smoke compatibility.

steps.title: Harden Phase1Scheduler and scheduling lifecycle semantics
steps.notes: Dispatched to subagent 019ddd2f-1202-7702-b1d1-399926c93cb0 and merged. Scheduler now has direct query helpers/tests and tightened Yielded/budget behavior.

steps.title: Implement bus-backed wait_event and lost-wake-safe subscription
steps.notes: Dispatched to subagent 019ddd2f-1225-7961-9cf0-a227cc1499e0 and coordinator-wired through tx_substrate::bus. wait_event now uses check/register/recheck before parking and rechecks after wakes.

steps.title: Implement HAL-driven timer adapter and long-running idle loop
steps.notes: Dispatched to subagent 019ddd2f-1246-7c60-889c-d04bf2b2a53c and merged. run_until_idle_with_clock preserves host tests and provides a HAL TimeIf-shaped adapter. CoreInit wiring waits until the init.rs lease clears.

steps.title: Add interrupt source classification to wait_event
steps.notes: Dispatched to subagent 019ddd4d-1d01-79f3-a3c6-f83ddf144832 and merged. Adds the THREAD_RUNTIME_v1 InterruptSource seam and wait_event_with_interrupts classification without signal queues, dispositions, thread entities, or AST delivery.

steps.title: Add AST and preemption marker surfaces with tests
steps.notes: Dispatched to subagent 019ddd4d-1d2a-79e2-a921-6b6a718150b2 and merged. Adds task-local AST marker batching and atomic preemption markers, leaving delivery policy and wait classification outside this lane.

steps.title: Implement counted and countdown completion middleware
steps.notes: Dispatched to subagent 019ddd4d-1d67-7c50-ba64-53e837abb863 and merged. Adds credit-consuming Completion and CountdownCompletion over Channel::wait_event; coordinator tightened CountdownCompletion construction to NonZeroU32 per COMPLETION_v1.

steps.title: Shape synchronous coordination for shootdown-style rendezvous
steps.notes: Dispatched to subagent 019ddd4d-1d3f-7f83-9f17-81e520673b25 and merged. Adds a reactor-local SyncRendezvous shape for shootdown-style acknowledgments; substrate shootdown wiring waits until the active tx-substrate lib.rs lease clears.

steps.title: Integrate second-wave reactor lanes and run full verification
steps.notes: Coordinator audited worker APIs against REACTOR_v0, THREAD_RUNTIME_v1, and COMPLETION_v1; accepted mechanism-only AST/sync surfaces; tightened CountdownCompletion to NonZeroU32; and recorded docs/progress/research/2026-04-30-reactor-second-wave-audit.md.

steps.title: Integrate worker lanes and run full reactor verification
steps.notes: Coordinator integrated runtime onto TaskTable, wired public tx_substrate::bus, added reactor-level lifecycle tests, and ran the full ci gate. See docs/progress/research/2026-04-30-reactor-first-wave-audit.md.
